[Discussion] What upcoming video games, if failing commercially, critically or getting cancelled, would have major impact on the gaming industry?

One never knows how something will impact an industry until it has happened, some times it isn't clearly known to have happened until long after.

The creation of WarCraft 3 allowed Dota to come about, the impact has been significant. At the time the mod came out nobody knew shit, at the time the game came out, there was no inclining of the mod. And yet an entire genre has grown from it.

Star Citizen. It has become the poster child for crowd funding, and if it fails it's quite possible that the resulting loss in faith of the crowd funding model could basically destroy it as a viable option for developers.

Not really. Many smaller kickstarted projects have been insanely successful (prison architect, undertale, darkest dungeon, pillars of eternity and so on). The model has proven its worth when it comes to properly managed, "small scale" teams. Star Citizen is another thing entirely.

But if we are talking mainstream gamers, they haven't heard of any of the games you mentioned. But they have heard of star citizen. Sure, if you pay attention to crowd funding, you can see the successes. But star citizen has over a million backers, most of whom probably haven't backed anything else. If they get burned, that's a lot of people who have been turned against crowd funding as a con practice. I think that it's perfectly feasible that they could influence the general zeitgeist to believe that as well.

I'm actually not so sure about that to be honest. These games may not make as many headlines as Star Citizen, but they are also far more numerous and cover more genres and potential niches. On top of that, the last time people reading some form of gaming media have heard about Star Citizen was that whole debacle with Derek Smart & co. Star Citizen sparked the interest of many back when it was breaking millions after millions in funding, but now that is very well in the past, and the release "schedule" isn't making things any better when it comes to exposure.

The rule is, games only ever release once. And most of those who want to play Star Citizen are already playing the alpha.

I would say some casual game on a popular franchise. While Clash of Clans is safe at the moment, I assume that it can't be said to all games.

Another would be Mighty No 9 and many other Kickstarter games as that would greatly discourage people from backing games.

I don't think a single videogame failing or being cancelled can cause a major impact in the industry. However, a group of them can. Probably the most popular Kickstarter games either being released and being bad or being cancelled would cause a bit of a stir.

  • Star Citizen

  • Mighty No 6

  • Yooka-Laylee

Maybe sequels or yearly releases as well. Some companies really do put a lot into sequels, because they make money. The second they don't, they're lost and scrambling to find something to replace the money cow.

  • Call Of Duty

  • BattleField

  • Assassins Creed

  • Madden/NBA

Though if you want games that might single handily cause some uproar should they be a disaster, then:

  • The Division

  • Final Fantasy [Insert number here]

  • Shemue III

  • The Last Guardian

  • Half-Life 3

  • any highly anticipated game with large promises

  • any vaporware games with a huge following
